verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents its own bulk capabilities in two areas: bulk email verification through its Email Verification API, and operations on lists of templates. Beyond those two resource types, the evidence shows no general bulk or batch operation support. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch email sending, bulk operations across other resources (domains, recipients, messages), limits and behavior of bulk endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Verify a single email address or in bulk with MailerSend's Email Verification API.
Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
